about_the_game:
Your favourite colour-coded block-pushing duo are back!

Enough is never enough!

Their questionable appetite for appropriately-hued gems unabated by their adventures in the Mine of Mages, Gemima and Jules explore a whole new map packed with brand new puzzles, new game mechanics, new secrets, and truly abysmal puns.

At least 20% more puzzley goodness than the original!

Over 100 levels await to tax your brain and, optionally, your ability to coexist peacefully with another human being despite them killing you with a rock again after you specifically told them not to move what were they even thinking.

Brand new game mechanics!

After a couple of refresher puzzles to remind you of the basics, The Ice Golem Fortress is a whole new challenge to wrap your head around, so don't worry: you needn't have completed the original to enjoy this DLC.

Just how much worse ARE the puns this time?

That's difficult to express without inventing a new mathematical notation. They are very, very bad.

How difficult are the puzzles, and how long should it take me to finish the game?

Puzzles in the Ice Golem Fortress range from moderate to very challenging, and there are lots of them. Unless you are a puzzle expert, don't expect to be done inside 24 hours.

What about secrets and easter-eggs? I always buy games if they have those.

The Ice Golem Fortress has a whole bunch of them to reward those who possess <sharp look> the predisposition...

Was AI used in any way during the creation of this DLC?

To the extent any intelligence at all was involved in the process, it is certified 100% meat-based, organic, and computin'-free.

Did I mention how bad the puns were?

short_description: More block-pushing, head-scratching, laptop-flinging puzzles for one or two players! Delve into the Ice Golem Fortress and...steal all their stuff? Am I reading this right? Well, it's a little on the nose, don't you think? No, I'm not being paid to editorialise. I'm barely being paid at all.
